get.description: Retrieves original value, consideration, funding provenance and remaining attributable value for one load.

Lists recipient notification identities, schedules and delivery outcomes. No redemption codes or recipient access tokens are returned. Default order: gift_card_notification_id descending; this key uniquely orders the results.

post.description: Creates a recipient email notification, immediately or up to 90 days from now. A resend creates a new resource with resend_of_notification_id. An unconfirmed send must be resolved before another send is requested. Sending does not change gift card value or order fulfillment.

get.description: Retrieves a notification and its sending outcome. Sent means the sending provider accepted the message; it does not mean the recipient read it.

post.description: Cancels a notification before sending starts or after confirmed failure. A sending or unconfirmed notification cannot be canceled. Gift card value is preserved.

get.description: Lists reservations and captured redemptions in descending ID order. Retrieve by idempotency_key to recover an operation after a lost response. Default order: gift_card_redemption_id descending; this key uniquely orders the results.

post.description: Posts an exact amount automatically or reserves it for one full manual capture. Insufficient funds are rejected without a partial debit. Manual reservations default to 15 minutes and may be bounded up to 24 hours. External integrations coordinate and compensate their other tenders themselves. expected_gift_card_version fences the version of the card in gift_card_id.

get.description: Retrieves requested, reserved, captured, refunded and remaining refundable value with the current reservation status.

post.description: Releases an uncaptured standalone reservation without posting a debit or refund. Flint order reservations cannot be released while a processor outcome is unresolved. expected_version fences the redemption version.

Posts the full reserved amount before the manual reservation expires. Capturing and expiry use the same concurrency fence. Flint order reservations are resolved by their payment attempt and cannot be captured through this standalone operation. expected_version fences the redemption version.

get.description: Lists immutable financial entries across the merchant in ascending merchant_sequence order. Per-card sequences and balance snapshots support reconciliation. Reservations and code replacement never create financial debits. Default order: merchant_sequence ascending; this key uniquely orders the results.

Lists gift cards in descending ID order within the authenticated merchant and environment. Reads include masked codes, posted balance, reserved value and available value. Purchased cards have no expiry or service fees. Default order: gift_card_id descending; this key uniquely orders the results.

post.description: Creates a merchant-issued USD gift card with optional paid funding or imported opening value. External funding is merchant-attested and does not collect a payment. The full code is returned only by issuance or code replacement and their authorized retries for 24 hours, while that code remains current. Replacing a code ends recovery of that code. Financial command identity is retained for the lifetime of the ledger.

Evaluates a full bearer code in a request body. Codes contain 16 ASCII Crockford base32 characters, accept lowercase and hyphens, and normalize O to 0 and I/L to 1. Lookup is side-effect-free and never reserves funds. Unknown, other-merchant and unusable codes return the same error.
post.summary: Look up a gift card code

get.description: Retrieves the current gift card, including supported lifecycle actions and balance projections. A gift card ID does not authorize a buyer to spend it.

patch.description: Updates descriptive associations. Omitted fields are preserved; null clears external_reference_id or customer_id. This operation cannot change balances, currency, code or status. expected_version fences the gift card version.

post.description: Posts a relative correction with a typed reason and separate administrative authority. Corrections cannot consume reserved funds, exceed funding limits, or replace linked refunds and purchase reversals. expected_version fences the gift card version.

Records cash that the merchant attests it paid to the cardholder. Flint does not send cash. A freeze, restriction, or unresolved funding dispute blocks cash-out with ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED and reason restricted; remove the restriction before retrying. The amount cannot exceed unreserved value or consume payment reservations; cash_out_reference identifies the cash disbursement the merchant made outside Flint. expected_version fences the gift card version.
Permanently closes a card with zero balance, no reservations, no unresolved restrictions and no pending purchase refunds. expected_version fences the gift card version.
Freezes spending on an active or frozen card with a merchant reason. Accepted payment reservations remain intact. expected_version fences the gift card version.

Invalidates the old bearer credential and generates a new code for the same gift card. Balances, funding, reservations and refund history are preserved. Requires commerce.gift_cards.secrets.write. Include notification to send the new private recipient link. Retired links cannot open the current code. The new full code is available in this response and authorized retries only within 24 hours, while that code remains current. expected_version fences the gift card version.
Removes a merchant freeze and restores spending. Unresolved funding-dispute restrictions refuse this action. expected_version fences the gift card version.

get.description: List inventory adjustments. Default order: inventory_adjustment_id ascending; this key uniquely orders the results.

post.description: Record a stock change by what happened: stock received, returned, sold, stolen, lost, or moved between conditions, or an absolute count or correction. Flint computes the change against the current level. Returns the adjustment, its movement IDs, and the resulting level for every level touched. Idempotency is scoped to the authenticated merchant, environment, and endpoint. Its fingerprint includes the canonical request body. To recover the command's effects after a lost response, list inventory adjustments with the same idempotency_key, or list inventory movements with that idempotency_key.

get.description: Retrieve an inventory adjustment and its lines by ID.
List allocation policies. Archived policies are excluded unless you filter by status archived. Default order: inventory_allocation_policy_id ascending; this key uniquely orders the results.

post.description: Create an allocation policy with its routing configuration. Idempotency is scoped to the authenticated merchant, environment, and endpoint. Its fingerprint includes the canonical request body. To recover the command's effects after a lost response, list inventory allocation policies and identify the matching policy.

delete.description: Retire an allocation policy. The policy is archived: it stays readable by ID and appears in lists only when you filter by status archived.

get.description: Retrieve an allocation policy by ID, including archived policies.

patch.description: Update policy fields, availability, or atomically replace its routing configuration. expected_version is optional and enforced when sent, and is required when replacing configuration. Idempotency is scoped to the authenticated merchant, environment, and endpoint. Its fingerprint includes the canonical request body. To recover the command's effects after a lost response, read the inventory allocation policy by ID.

get.description: List immutable revisions of an allocation policy, newest first by default. Default order: inventory_allocation_policy_revision_id descending; this key uniquely orders the results.
Retrieve the immutable routing configuration captured by one allocation policy revision.
List inventory counts. Default order: inventory_count_id ascending; this key uniquely orders the results.

post.description: Open a physical count for selected inventory items at one Location. Idempotency is scoped to the authenticated merchant, environment, and endpoint. Its fingerprint includes the canonical request body. To recover the command's effects after a lost response, list inventory counts with the same idempotency_key.

get.description: Retrieve an inventory count and its saved observations by ID.

patch.description: Replace a count's complete observation set atomically. expected_version is required when replacing observations. Send every item exactly once with the count's current expected_version and each observation's required expected_physical_version. Read the level before physically counting; zero is valid for a missing level. Every assertion must match locked current stock or the whole save is refused. Preserve saved quantities and fences for unchanged lines. Recount affected items before supplying fresh fences, even when quantities are unchanged. Omitted condition quantities retain the matching level snapshot's values. occurred_at records provenance and does not reconstruct historical stock. Idempotency is scoped to the authenticated merchant, environment, and endpoint. Its fingerprint includes the canonical request body. To recover the command's effects after a lost response, read the inventory count by ID.

post.description: Sets inventory levels to the counted quantities of an open physical count. Every line needs an observation. VERSION_CONFLICT also covers a stale saved physical observation with no corresponding field in this request; these details omit param. Recount affected items and save the complete observations before applying again. Physical changes after observation require recounts, including at a trading location; holds and commitments alone do not invalidate observations. Call it only when apply is in supported_actions. Returns a result with inventory_count as its primary resource and inventory_levels for the levels changed. Idempotency is scoped to the authenticated merchant, environment, and endpoint. Its fingerprint includes the canonical request body. To recover the command's effects after a lost response, read the inventory count by ID.

Closes an open physical count without changing stock. Call it only when cancel is in supported_actions. Returns a result with inventory_count as its primary resource and inventory_levels for the levels changed. Idempotency is scoped to the authenticated merchant, environment, and endpoint. Its fingerprint includes the canonical request body. To recover the command's effects after a lost response, read the inventory count by ID.

get.description: List inventory items. Archived items are excluded unless you filter by status archived. Default order: inventory_item_id ascending; this key uniquely orders the results.

post.description: Create an inventory item. SKU and barcode are searchable attributes, not identity: they are not required to be unique. Idempotency is scoped to the authenticated merchant, environment, and endpoint. Its fingerprint includes the canonical request body. To recover the command's effects after a lost response, list inventory items by the external_reference_id, sku, or barcode you supplied, then read the matching item.

delete.description: Retire an inventory item. The item is archived: it stays readable by ID and appears in lists only when you filter by status archived.

get.description: Retrieve an inventory item by ID, including archived items.

patch.description: Update an inventory item. Accepts status active or inactive. Send sku or barcode as null to clear. expected_version is optional and enforced when sent. Idempotency is scoped to the authenticated merchant, environment, and endpoint. Its fingerprint includes the canonical request body. To recover the command's effects after a lost response, read the inventory item by ID.

get.description: List inventory levels. Send expand=inventory_item to render each level's inventory item inline, so a stock table needs no read per row. Filter by inventory_item_status to see only the levels behind items that can be sold. Levels are strongly consistent individually, but pages may reflect different committed instants. Default order: inventory_level_id ascending; this key uniquely orders the results.
Retrieve an inventory level's current quantities and version by ID.

patch.description: Set one inventory level's safety_stock_quantity. expected_version is optional and enforced when sent. The version changes on every quantity or claim change, including holds and commits, so read the level immediately before a PATCH. Returns the updated inventory level. Idempotency is scoped to the authenticated merchant, environment, and endpoint. Its fingerprint includes the canonical request body. To recover the command's effects after a lost response, read the inventory level by ID.

get.description: List inventory movements, oldest recorded first. Send expand=inventory_item to render each movement's inventory item inline, so a history table needs no read per row. Filter by idempotency_key to recover the movements a command produced. Send sort_direction=desc to read the newest movements first. Default order: created_at ascending, then inventory_movement_id ascending.
Retrieve an inventory movement and its stock changes by ID.

List completed inventory receipt effects. Use typed Return filters for reconciliation when the receipt was created by Returns. Default order: inventory_receipt_id ascending; this key uniquely orders the results.

post.description: Record returned units against a consumed inventory reservation and their disposition. For supplier deliveries, use POST /v1/inventory-adjustments with reason: received. This is a downstream stock effect, not the customer Return lifecycle. Idempotency is scoped to the authenticated merchant, environment, and endpoint. Its fingerprint includes the canonical request body. To recover the command's effects after a lost response, list inventory receipts with the same idempotency_key, or list inventory movements with that idempotency_key.

get.description: Retrieve a completed inventory receipt and its disposition lines by ID.

List inventory reservations in ascending inventory_reservation_id order. Omit owner_type to include merchant and order owners. owner_key matches merchant owners only. Default order: inventory_reservation_id ascending; this key uniquely orders the results.

post.description: Route standalone merchant demand and hold stock in one atomic command. A hold defaults to 15 minutes and can last up to 24 hours. Set expires_at when creating it or PATCH the reservation to change its deadline. Idempotency is scoped to the authenticated merchant, environment, and endpoint. Its fingerprint includes the canonical request body. To recover the command's effects after a lost response, list inventory reservations with the same idempotency_key.

get.description: Retrieve an inventory reservation and its lines by ID, including merchant and order owners.

patch.description: Change the hold deadline of a reservation you created. The new expires_at must be after now and at most 24 hours from now, and can be earlier or later than the current one. A lapsed hold cannot be extended, and reservations Flint holds for orders cannot be changed. Committed and consumed quantity never expire.

post.description: Commits held quantity, usually once the buyer pays. Commit before expires_at: after the deadline, commit returns 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason terminal_status. Call it only when commit is in supported_actions. Lines carry cumulative targets: resending targets already applied succeeds even after the reservation closes. Returns a result with inventory_reservation as its primary resource and inventory_levels for the levels changed. Idempotency is scoped to the authenticated merchant, environment, and endpoint. Its fingerprint includes the canonical request body. To recover the command's effects after a lost response, read the inventory reservation by ID.

Consumes committed quantity when you hand the goods off, removing it from on-hand stock. Accepts provenance describing the handoff. Call it only when consume is in supported_actions. Lines carry cumulative targets: resending targets already applied succeeds even after the reservation closes. Returns a result with inventory_reservation as its primary resource and inventory_levels for the levels changed. Idempotency is scoped to the authenticated merchant, environment, and endpoint. Its fingerprint includes the canonical request body. To recover the command's effects after a lost response, read the inventory reservation by ID.

Releases held or committed quantity back to available stock, for example when the buyer leaves or you cancel after payment. Call it only when release is in supported_actions. Lines carry cumulative targets: resending targets already applied succeeds even after the reservation closes. Returns a result with inventory_reservation as its primary resource and inventory_levels for the levels changed. Idempotency is scoped to the authenticated merchant, environment, and endpoint. Its fingerprint includes the canonical request body. To recover the command's effects after a lost response, read the inventory reservation by ID.

get.description: List inventory transfers. Default order: inventory_transfer_id ascending; this key uniquely orders the results.

post.description: Create a planned stock transfer between two Locations. Creates a draft and moves no stock, so an idempotency key is optional: each request without a key creates a separate draft. With a key, a retry must send the same request body, and idempotency is scoped to the authenticated merchant, environment, and endpoint. To recover a keyed create after a lost response, list inventory transfers with idempotency_key.

get.description: Retrieve an inventory transfer, its lines, and supported_actions by ID.

patch.description: Update an open transfer's planning details. Sending lines replaces the owned collection atomically and requires expected_version. For metadata-only edits, expected_version is optional and enforced when sent. Omitted fields stay unchanged. Send external_reference_id: null to clear it.

post.description: Cancels requested quantity that hasn't departed. Call it only when cancel is in supported_actions. Lines carry cumulative targets, not deltas. Returns a result with inventory_transfer as its primary resource and inventory_levels for the levels changed. Idempotency is scoped to the authenticated merchant, environment, and endpoint. Its fingerprint includes the canonical request body. To recover the command's effects after a lost response, read the inventory transfer by ID.

Takes stock off the origin location and puts it in transit. Call it only when depart is in supported_actions. Lines carry cumulative targets, not deltas. Returns a result with inventory_transfer as its primary resource and inventory_levels for the levels changed. Idempotency is scoped to the authenticated merchant, environment, and endpoint. Its fingerprint includes the canonical request body. To recover the command's effects after a lost response, read the inventory transfer by ID.

Adds in-transit stock to the destination location. Optional condition targets split the received quantity by condition. Call it only when receive is in supported_actions. Lines carry cumulative targets, not deltas. Returns a result with inventory_transfer as its primary resource and inventory_levels for the levels changed. Idempotency is scoped to the authenticated merchant, environment, and endpoint. Its fingerprint includes the canonical request body. To recover the command's effects after a lost response, read the inventory transfer by ID.

Records in-transit stock as lost. Call it only when report_loss is in supported_actions. Lines carry cumulative targets, not deltas. Returns a result with inventory_transfer as its primary resource and inventory_levels for the levels changed. Idempotency is scoped to the authenticated merchant, environment, and endpoint. Its fingerprint includes the canonical request body. To recover the command's effects after a lost response, read the inventory transfer by ID.

Puts in-transit stock back at the origin location. Call it only when return_to_origin is in supported_actions. Lines carry cumulative targets, not deltas. Returns a result with inventory_transfer as its primary resource and inventory_levels for the levels changed. Idempotency is scoped to the authenticated merchant, environment, and endpoint. Its fingerprint includes the canonical request body. To recover the command's effects after a lost response, read the inventory transfer by ID.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of invoice payment terms for the authenticated merchant. Default order: created_at descending, then invoice_payment_term_id descending.

post.description: Creates a reusable payment term that decides when an invoice is due, for example on receipt, net days, or a day of the month. Send `name` and `calculation`. A late fee policy is optional; it applies to overdue invoices and is frozen on an invoice when the invoice is issued.

delete.description: Retires an invoice payment term by setting its status to archived. A default payment term cannot be retired.

get.description: Returns one invoice payment term for the authenticated merchant.

patch.description: Update invoice payment term for the authenticated merchant. Null is rejected for name, calculation, and expected_version; omit them to leave them unchanged. Null clears late_fee_policy or external_reference_id.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of invoices for the authenticated merchant. Default order: created_at descending, then invoice_id descending.

post.description: Creates an invoice draft from exactly one source: order_id for an order-backed invoice, or quick_pay for an invoice with a new backing order. Include issue to issue it immediately, using merchant_default delivery when issue is empty. An idempotency key is required for every request because issuing an automatic-collection invoice can charge the buyer. Replays preserve the original invoice result and recover its current public_url only within 24 hours of the original request; later replays omit public_url. Use GET /v1/invoices/{invoice_id} for the current invoice. If Flint returns IDEMPOTENCY_RECOVERY_REQUIRED, look up the original with GET /v1/invoices?idempotency_key={key}. Send the create again under a new key only after confirming it created no invoice, and contact Flint support with the request_id if you can't tell.

get.description: Returns a single invoice by ID.

patch.description: Updates mutable fields on a draft invoice. Null is rejected for cc_emails, collection, payment_due, schedule_entries, reminders_paused, and expected_version; omit them to leave them unchanged. Send [] to clear cc_emails or the authored schedule. After issue, the only writable field is reminders_paused, which pauses or resumes automatic reminders on an open or partially paid invoice.

get.description: Returns a read-only history of an invoice for timelines and debugging, newest first. Use sort_direction=asc for chronological order. Read the invoice and the resources each row references for authoritative state. Default order: created_at descending, then invoice_activity_id descending.

post.description: Charges the invoice's saved payment method or the supplied saved payment method. Send a caller-chosen idempotency key, and reuse it when you retry the same collection.

get.description: Returns email delivery attempts for send and reminder actions. Default order: created_at descending, then invoice_delivery_attempt_id ascending.

post.description: Issues the invoice, creates the buyer-access link, and uses the selected delivery mode. Safe to retry with the same idempotency key.
Assesses the frozen late fee policy once per invoice or overdue schedule entry. The issued document remains unchanged.
Waives the unpaid remainder of an assessed late fee. Collected money is not refunded. The reason is visible only to the merchant.
post.summary: Waive an unpaid invoice late fee

get.description: Lists every manual payment, including reversed payments. Default order: received_at descending, then invoice_manual_payment_id descending.

post.description: Applies an offline/manual payment to an issued invoice. The monthly allowance for orders paid outside Flint never prevents recording a payment. When the order is above its current allowance, meta.warnings includes external_paid_orders_over_allowance with the order resource_id and the original usage period's resets_at. A replay preserves that original reset time. Recording is rejected with OPERATION_IN_PROGRESS while an online payment is still resolving; an idle open checkout does not block. A payment that clears the balance invalidates the open checkout session. Safe to retry with the same idempotency key.

get.description: Returns one recorded or reversed manual payment for the invoice.

post.description: Reverses the named manual payment in full and returns its amount to the invoice balance. To correct an amount, reverse the payment and record the correct payment. A retry with the same idempotency key replays the result; a retry without a key fails once the payment is already reversed.
Closes the outstanding balance as a write-off and releases the order's invoice collection authority. Safe to retry with the same idempotency key.

get.description: Lists card and ACH collection attempts for an invoice in reverse chronological order. Default order: started_at descending, then invoice_payment_attempt_id descending.
Returns one card or ACH collection attempt for the invoice.

post.description: Cancels an active invoice payment attempt and its payment intent. A processing ACH debit can be canceled only until the payment processor sends it to the bank; after that the request returns 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason in_progress and the attempt stays processing. Safe to retry with the same idempotency key. Accepts an empty body or {}.

get.description: Downloads the merchant-authenticated PDF artifact generated from the invoice snapshot.

post.description: Revokes the current buyer-access link and all checkout credentials derived from it, then returns a new public_url. The current checkout session and its payment lineage are preserved. Fails with `ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED` and reason `in_progress` when the invoice's customer is being deleted or has been deleted. Safe to retry with the same idempotency key.
Attempts a reminder email for an already issued collectible invoice. Safe to retry with the same idempotency key. Accepts an empty body or {}.

Voids an unpaid invoice and releases its collection authority. For a Quick Pay invoice, also closes the order with closed_reason invoice_voided only when it is open with no collected payment and no fulfillment. Otherwise the order is unchanged. An invoice with an issued credit note against it cannot be voided until that credit note is voided.

get.description: List Locations. inventory_allocation_enabled is always included and can be filtered with the Location read scope. The false filter includes Locations without an inventory allocation configuration. Default order: location_id ascending; this key uniquely orders the results.

post.description: Create a Location. Sending inventory_allocation_enabled also requires commerce.inventory.allocation.write. Omitted inventory_allocation_enabled defaults to false. Every Location can hold stock. Idempotency is scoped to the authenticated merchant, environment, and endpoint. Its fingerprint includes the canonical request body.

delete.description: Retire a Location. Preserves the archived resource for direct reads. Repeating DELETE returns the archived Location without changing its version or timestamps. An explicitly supplied expected_version must still match.

get.description: Returns one location by ID, with its address, timezone, status, and whether it accepts inventory allocation. Archived locations remain readable by ID.

patch.description: Update a Location's profile, availability, geography, and inventory allocation in one call. Sending inventory_allocation_enabled also requires commerce.inventory.allocation.write. The version advances on every change. expected_version is optional and compared with version when sent. Idempotency is scoped to the authenticated merchant, environment, and endpoint. Its fingerprint includes the canonical request body. An archived Location cannot be changed: the request returns 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason archived and current_status archived.

get.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns the buyer's customer profile.

patch.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. Updates the current buyer's name or phone. Manage billing and shipping addresses through /v1/me/addresses. A closed store is read-only: commerce changes fail with 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED and reason terminal_status. Receipts and order history remain readable.

get.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Lists the buyer's saved addresses with their billing and shipping default flags. Default order: created_at descending, then customer_address_id descending.

post.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Saves an address for the buyer. The address becomes a default only when the request sets is_default_billing or is_default_shipping, or later by setting those flags with PATCH, including the buyer's first address. A default address is also the billing or shipping address on the buyer's customer profile. A closed store is read-only: commerce changes fail with 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED and reason terminal_status. Receipts and order history remain readable.
post.summary: Create an address for the current buyer

delete.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Deletes one of the buyer's saved addresses. Deleting the billing or shipping default leaves the customer with none; Flint doesn't pick another address. A closed store is read-only: commerce changes fail with 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED and reason terminal_status. Receipts and order history remain readable.
delete.summary: Delete one of the current buyer's addresses

get.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns one of the buyer's saved addresses.
get.summary: Get one of the current buyer's addresses

patch.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Changes the fields you send on one of the buyer's saved addresses. The address field replaces the whole postal address. Send null for phone or label to remove it. Set is_default_billing or is_default_shipping to true to make this address the default, or false to clear a default it holds. Changing a default address also changes the matching address on the buyer's customer profile. A closed store is read-only: commerce changes fail with 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED and reason terminal_status. Receipts and order history remain readable.
patch.summary: Update one of the current buyer's addresses

post.description: Accepts a customer session, which limits the request to that customer's invoices, or the access token from this invoice's public link, which limits it to this invoice. The request cannot select a customer_id. Creates or reuses a hosted or headless checkout session for something the buyer owes. With type return_resolution, it collects the buyer's balance on one of their return resolutions' replacement order. With type invoice, it collects what is due now on one of the buyer's invoices; an invoice access token works for its own invoice only. The response is 200 when it reuses the open session with the same surface and 201 when it creates one. Omit surface to use hosted; changing surface replaces an idle session and is refused while a payment is in progress. Use redirects to set where the buyer goes after paying or canceling. The return_url field is an alias for redirects.success_url on hosted checkout or payment_return_url on headless checkout and must be an address of the merchant's customer account. A reused session takes a new success destination only until a payment starts, then keeps its existing destination. When the store cannot accept payments, a new payment fails with 409 MERCHANT_NOT_READY and reason processing_restricted. Changes billed at a future renewal remain available. A closed store is read-only: commerce changes fail with 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED and reason terminal_status. Receipts and order history remain readable.
post.summary: Create a checkout session for the current buyer

get.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. Lists the current buyer's deletion requests in the selected merchant environment, newest first by requested_at. Default order: requested_at descending, then customer_deletion_request_id descending.
get.summary: List the current buyer's deletion requests

post.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Asks the store to delete the buyer's account, or returns the request already pending. The store approves or rejects it. Deletion anonymizes the customer: orders, payments, and refunds stay without the buyer's identity.
post.summary: Request deletion of the current buyer's account

get.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns the status of one of the buyer's deletion requests.
get.summary: Get the current buyer's deletion request

post.description: Sends short-lived confirmation codes to the current and new email addresses. If the account has no current email, only the new address must be confirmed. The customer email does not change until confirmation succeeds. Limited to three attempts per 15 minutes, including attempts rejected because the email is already used. A rejected attempt keeps any pending email change request. Over the limit, the request fails with `RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`; wait the whole seconds until the oldest counted attempt leaves the window, at least 1, before trying again.

Confirms possession of the current and new email addresses, then atomically updates the customer account in the selected merchant environment. Omit current_email_code only when current_email_confirmation_required is false. A successful confirmation signs the buyer out everywhere at this store: it revokes every customer session, buyer access grant, and Flint-hosted account session for the customer, including the session that made this request. Cards saved with Flint stay at the previous email unless a customer session that can access them sends move_flint_wallet: true. Those sessions receive flint_wallet_outcome when the previous email had saved cards. Sign the buyer in again with the new email.

get.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. Returns which of the merchant's optional email categories the customer's current email receives in the selected merchant environment. A category the buyer never changed is on. Email preferences exist only for a customer with an email: without one, the read fails with `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`. Receipts and other transactional email always send.
get.summary: Get the current buyer's email preferences

patch.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. Turns the optional email categories in the body on or off for the customer's current email at this merchant in the selected merchant environment, and leaves the others as they are. The setting follows the email address, so it also covers guest checkouts with the same email. A customer without an email has no email preferences, and the change fails with `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`.
patch.summary: Update the current buyer's email preferences

get.description: Returns the current buyer's usable wallet cards in newest-first order. Each flint_wallet_card_id is an opaque per-store handle. store_payment_method_id is null until this store holds a copy. Requires a customer session minted from a live email-code buyer login at a Flint-hosted store account, including a login narrowed to a custom domain. Email links, checkout sessions, grants, merchant-created sessions, and API keys can't see the wallet and get a not-found response. Live and sandbox wallets are isolated. The full card collection is returned in one page. Flint wallet support must be enabled. Default order: most recently added card first.
get.summary: List cards saved with Flint for this store

post.description: Records the buyer's consent to save an independent store copy for off-session payments, including subscriptions. Call only after the buyer agrees. Requires a live email-code buyer login and an enabled Flint wallet at a Flint-hosted store account. Supply a flint_wallet_card_id from listMeFlintWalletCards. Confirm client_setup with Stripe.js confirmSetup, then poll GET /v1/me/payment-methods/{payment_method_id} until active before changing a subscription through PATCH /v1/me/subscriptions/{subscription_id} with payment_method_id. Setup may request authentication. Removing the platform card or revoking store consent blocks the copy immediately. An idempotency key is optional and scoped to the store, customer, card handle, and key. Responses are retained for 24 hours. After a copy is revoked, retries with any key bound to that copy are refused. Get new consent and use a new key to create another copy. Retry a lost response with the same key. Concurrent requests for the same card at this store share one copy and setup. A failed off-session charge can still require the buyer to return through the existing card-update link. Accept an empty body or {}. A closed store is read-only: commerce changes fail with 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED and reason terminal_status. Receipts and order history remain readable.
post.summary: Set up a Flint wallet card at this store

get.description: Lists fulfillment events for an order owned by the current buyer, ordered by occurred_at descending. Internal merchant fields are omitted. order_id is required. Default order: occurred_at descending, then fulfillment_event_id descending.
get.summary: List the current buyer's fulfillment events

get.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Lists fulfillments for the buyer's orders, newest created first. Default order: created_at descending, then fulfillment_id descending.
Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns one of the buyer's fulfillments.
get.summary: Get one of the current buyer's fulfillments

get.description: Requires a full customer session. Saved access requires possession of a current code or recipient link. Customer associations and purchase history do not authorize access. Replacing a code invalidates saved access; save again with fresh proof. Saved access does not permit spending or reveal a full code. Lists the full anonymous balance-change history by per-card sequence, descending. Other holders' identities and order references are omitted. Default order: sequence descending; this key uniquely orders the results.
get.summary: List a saved gift card's balance history

get.description: Requires a full customer session. Saved access requires possession of a current code or recipient link. Customer associations and purchase history do not authorize access. Replacing a code invalidates saved access; save again with fresh proof. Saved access does not permit spending or reveal a full code. Lists valid saved cards by saved time then card ID, descending. Default order: time the buyer saved the card (descending), then gift_card_id descending.

post.description: Requires a full customer session. Saved access requires possession of a current code or recipient link. Customer associations and purchase history do not authorize access. Replacing a code invalidates saved access; save again with fresh proof. Saved access does not permit spending or reveal a full code. Idempotency keys are scoped to the buyer, merchant, environment, and operation. A replay cannot restore removed or revoked saved access. A closed store is read-only: commerce changes fail with 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED and reason terminal_status. Receipts and order history remain readable.
post.summary: Save a gift card to your account

delete.description: Requires a full customer session. Saved access requires possession of a current code or recipient link. Customer associations and purchase history do not authorize access. Replacing a code invalidates saved access; save again with fresh proof. Saved access does not permit spending or reveal a full code. Removes only this buyer's saved access without changing funds or other holders' access. A repeated removal without an idempotency key fails with `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` because saved access is already absent. Reusing the same idempotency key replays the original removal snapshot without restoring saved access. Idempotency keys are scoped to the buyer, merchant, environment, and operation. A replay cannot restore removed or revoked saved access. A closed store is read-only: commerce changes fail with 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED and reason terminal_status. Receipts and order history remain readable.

get.description: Requires a full customer session. Saved access requires possession of a current code or recipient link. Customer associations and purchase history do not authorize access. Replacing a code invalidates saved access; save again with fresh proof. Saved access does not permit spending or reveal a full code.

Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Lists the buyer's invoices. Draft invoices are never returned. Default order: created_at descending, then invoice_id descending.

Accepts a customer session, which limits the request to that customer's invoices, or the access token from this invoice's public link, which limits it to this invoice. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns one of the buyer's invoices. A draft invoice fails with `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`.
get.summary: Get one of the current buyer's invoices

get.description: Accepts a customer session, which limits the request to that customer's invoices, or the access token from this invoice's public link, which limits it to this invoice. The request cannot select a customer_id. Lists the credit notes issued against this invoice, newest first. Default order: issued_at descending, then credit_note_id descending.
get.summary: List credit notes for one of the current buyer's invoices

get.description: Accepts a customer session, which limits the request to that customer's invoices, or the access token from this invoice's public link, which limits it to this invoice. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns one credit note with its lines, total, and the credit still available to allocate.
get.summary: Get a credit note for one of the current buyer's invoices

get.description: Accepts a customer session, which limits the request to that customer's invoices, or the access token from this invoice's public link, which limits it to this invoice. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns the credit note document as application/pdf rather than a JSON envelope. The PDF exists from issue onward and shows the credited lines, totals, and the invoice it corrects. It uses your current branding, so a later download can differ in logo or colors, but not in content.
get.summary: Download a credit note for one of the current buyer's invoices

get.description: Accepts a customer session, which limits the request to that customer's invoices, or the access token from this invoice's public link, which limits it to this invoice. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns the invoice document as application/pdf rather than a JSON envelope.
get.summary: Download one of the current buyer's invoices

get.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Lists the buyer's orders. Default order: created_at descending, then order_id descending.
Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns one of the buyer's orders.
get.summary: Get one of the current buyer's orders

get.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns a read-only, human-readable history log for an order. Use it to render timelines and debug what happened, not as a source of truth, ledger, or webhook replacement. Read the owning resource for authoritative state: the order for balances and status, the payment for payment state, the refund for refund outcomes, and the checkout session for checkout state. Do not sum balance_delta_money to compute an order balance. Informational rows such as payment_failed, refund_failed, and checkout_session_expired have a zero balance delta. The default order is newest first. Use sort_direction=asc for chronological timeline rendering. A typical chronological log might show created, payment_failed, payment, refund, then refund_failed; each row gives one reference to click through for the authoritative resource. Default order: created_at descending, then order_activity_id descending.
get.summary: List activity for one of the current buyer's orders

get.description: Downloads a numbered receipt for an order with collected money, covering successful payment intents and gift card redemptions, including payments and refunds. Orders paid only by manual cash, check, or wire invoice payments return 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason unsupported_state; download the invoice PDF instead. Mixed orders list only successful payment intents and gift card redemptions. Available under either order_receipts email delivery mode. Buyer and seller identity is frozen on the first snapshot write; payments, refunds, and branding are current.

post.description: Queues a receipt email for one of your paid orders to the order's email. Requires Flint-managed receipt delivery. Sending is limited to once every five minutes per order and normalized recipient.
post.summary: Send a receipt for one of the current buyer's orders

get.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Lists packages in the buyer's shipments, newest created first. Default order: created_at descending, then package_id descending.
Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns one of the buyer's packages.
get.summary: Get one of the current buyer's packages

get.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Lists the buyer's payments. Default order: created_at descending, then payment_intent_id descending.
Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns one of the buyer's payments.
get.summary: Get one of the current buyer's payments

get.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Lists payment methods in every status except archived, newest first. Filter by status=active for the cards you can charge. Filter by usage off_session to list the payment methods a subscription, automatic invoice, or default payment method can use. Default order: created_at descending, then payment_method_id descending.
get.summary: List the current buyer's payment methods

post.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Starts saving a payment method for the buyer and returns the client setup to confirm in the browser. The payment method is pending until setup succeeds. A closed store is read-only: commerce changes fail with 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED and reason terminal_status. Receipts and order history remain readable.
post.summary: Create a payment method for the current buyer

delete.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Deletes a saved payment method so it can no longer be used for future payments. Returns the payment method with status archived, including when it was already archived. A closed store is read-only: commerce changes fail with 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED and reason terminal_status. Receipts and order history remain readable.
delete.summary: Delete one of the current buyer's payment methods

get.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns one of the buyer's saved payment methods.
get.summary: Get one of the current buyer's payment methods

get.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Lists the buyer's refunds. Default order: created_at descending, then refund_id descending.
Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns one of the buyer's refunds.
get.summary: Get one of the current buyer's refunds

post.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Preview return eligibility or resolution amounts without creating a Return or reserving quantity. Set mode to eligibility or resolution and send the matching input object.
post.summary: Preview Return eligibility or resolution amounts for the current buyer

get.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns a buyer-visible Return resolution, including the amount the buyer needs to pay. Use the checkout_session action to pay its balance.
get.summary: Get one of the current buyer's Return resolutions

get.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Lists the buyer's Returns. Filter by order, return number, reason, status, decision, merchandise, resolution, or creation and update time. Default order: created_at descending, then return_id descending.

post.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Requests a Return for one of the buyer's orders. An active return policy must cover each line and leave the requested quantity eligible, or the request fails with `ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED` and reason `not_offered`. Check can_buyer_request with POST /v1/me/return-previews first. The buyer's reason must be active and apply to the line, and a policy that sends the request to review leaves the Return waiting for the store's decision. A closed store is read-only: commerce changes fail with 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED and reason terminal_status. Receipts and order history remain readable.
post.summary: Create a Return for the current buyer

get.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns one of the buyer's Returns.
get.summary: Get one of the current buyer's Returns

post.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Cancel a Return before any merchandise or value work commits. Cancellation is refused once a receipt, inspection, disposition, or resolution exists. A closed store is read-only: commerce changes fail with 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED and reason terminal_status. Receipts and order history remain readable.
post.summary: Cancel one of the current buyer's Returns

post.description: Signs out the current customer session using its current server-held secret, including after expiry, after revocation, or after its parent buyer session or grant ended. Repeating the call preserves revoked_at. A secret rotated away by refresh is invalid. Flint Account buyer sessions remain independent.

get.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Lists shipments for the buyer's orders and Returns, newest created first. Default order: created_at descending, then shipment_id descending.
Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns one of the buyer's shipments.
get.summary: Get one of the current buyer's shipments

post.description: Estimates a buyer's next subscription renewal, an offered plan change, or a quantity change, or lists delivery methods and rates for a proposed destination, without changing the subscription. plan_change uses the selected plan_change_options entry's billing_starts and the same checks and pricing as change-plan, including unused paid item credit when billing starts now or prorated_now. quantity_change accepts the change-quantity inputs with billing_starts prorated_now and returns the charge change-quantity would collect now, with the same refusals: only adjustable lines within min_quantity and max_quantity, and only eligible digital lines. next_renewal includes recurring promotions, shipping, and tax for the next charged cycle. Tax is null when tax can't be calculated yet; a tax service failure returns 502 EXTERNAL_SERVICE_ERROR. Requires a full buyer session. A preview does not reserve inventory or guarantee a future shipping rate.

get.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Lists the buyer's subscriptions. Subscriptions without a next_billing_at never match next_billing_after or next_billing_before, and sort last with sort_by=next_billing_at in either direction. subscription_plan is always included without expand: the plan's current summary, or null when the subscription has no plan. Default order: created_at descending, then subscription_id descending.

Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns one of the buyer's subscriptions. subscription_plan is always included without expand: the plan's current summary, or null when the subscription has no plan.
get.summary: Get one of the current buyer's subscriptions

patch.description: Updates payment_method_id, cancel_at_period_end: false, scheduled_plan_change: null, delivery, billing interval and quantity when the matching buyer action is available. Send billing_interval and billing_interval_count together. Mixed changes commit atomically. A scoped card-update session may send only payment_method_id and expected_version. Send expected_version to reject concurrent changes. A card whose setup hasn't finished fails with `ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED` and reason `status_not_reached`. Once setup finishes, send a new request with a new idempotency key. A closed store is read-only: commerce changes fail with 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED and reason terminal_status. Receipts and order history remain readable.

post.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Cancels a subscription and records who asked, why, and when in cancellation_details. With cancel_immediately: true it ends now. Otherwise, trialing ends at trial_end_at, active at current_period_end_at (or now when a renewal delivery hold has expired), and past_due at next_retry_at instead of that retry. Scheduled, incomplete, paused, and past_due without next_retry_at require cancel_immediately: true or fail with `ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED` and reason `period_end_unavailable`. Paid deliveries extend a scheduled cancellation to the last paid delivery when it is later. A merchant can cancel immediately without an automatic refund. A buyer cannot cancel immediately while prepaid deliveries remain and period-end cancellation is available; the refusal reason is `prepaid_deliveries_remaining`. Read scheduled_cancel_at for the scheduled end time. A buyer's cancellation follows the store's customer_account.buyer_capabilities. Send expected_version to reject a concurrent change. A closed store is read-only: commerce changes fail with 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED and reason terminal_status. Receipts and order history remain readable.
post.summary: Cancel one of the current buyer's subscriptions

post.description: Changes to a plan in the subscription's plan_change_options. Flint uses that option's billing_starts: now charges a new period with credit for unused paid item time and changes the plan only when payment succeeds; prorated_now charges the difference for the rest of the current period, keeps the period and anchor, and requires an unchanged interval; next_renewal changes the plan immediately without charging and keeps the current period and next billing date. Omit interval and quantity to keep their current values; the target plan must offer them. Requires a full buyer session and Idempotency-Key. Send expected_version to reject a concurrent change. Retry with the same key to recover the same result. Returns 200 including on decline, with the unchanged subscription, a closed unpaid order, and a failed order_payment_attempt. Inspect order_payment_attempt.last_payment_error before trying again. The order and order_payment_attempt are null when billing starts at the next renewal. When the store cannot accept payments, a new payment fails with 409 MERCHANT_NOT_READY and reason processing_restricted. Changes billed at a future renewal remain available. A closed store is read-only: commerce changes fail with 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED and reason terminal_status. Receipts and order history remain readable.

Changes the frozen adjustable subscription line within its min_quantity and max_quantity. Requires a full buyer session and Idempotency-Key. period_end schedules quantities for the next billing boundary using scheduled_plan_change; PATCH scheduled_plan_change to null to cancel. prorated_now charges the difference now for an eligible digital line and keeps the period and billing anchor. Physical quantities require period_end. Refuses with plan_change_scheduled while another change is pending. Retry with the same key to recover the original result. Returns 200 on decline with unchanged subscription; inspect order_payment_attempt.last_payment_error. The order and order_payment_attempt are null for period_end or zero net charge. Send expected_version to reject concurrent changes. When the store cannot accept payments, a new payment fails with 409 MERCHANT_NOT_READY and reason processing_restricted. Changes billed at a future renewal remain available. A closed store is read-only: commerce changes fail with 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED and reason terminal_status. Receipts and order history remain readable.

patch.description: Swaps a subscription line to an offered variant for future renewals. Requires a full buyer session. Send expected_version to reject concurrent changes. The replacement must remain deliverable to the subscription destination. A closed store is read-only: commerce changes fail with 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED and reason terminal_status. Receipts and order history remain readable.

post.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Pauses a subscription immediately. pause_duration_cycles counts delivery intervals on prepaid subscriptions and billing intervals otherwise; omit it for an indefinite pause. A pause with a duration resumes automatically at scheduled_resume_at. Repeating the stored pause length returns the paused subscription; a different length returns ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason field_locked and param pause_duration_cycles and requires resuming first. A buyer's pause follows the store's customer_account.buyer_capabilities. Send expected_version to reject a concurrent change. A closed store is read-only: commerce changes fail with 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED and reason terminal_status. Receipts and order history remain readable.
post.summary: Pause one of the current buyer's subscriptions

get.description: Returns a subscription's manual payment retries, newest first. Default order: created_at descending, then subscription_payment_retry_id descending.
get.summary: List payment retries for one of the current buyer's subscriptions

post.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. Starts one manual collection attempt on a past-due subscription. Send no body, or an empty object. Poll the returned retry for the outcome. While cancellation is scheduled, a new buyer retry fails with `ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED` and reason `cancellation_scheduled`, with `current_status` `past_due`. First use PATCH /v1/me/subscriptions/{subscription_id} with cancel_at_period_end false to keep the subscription; retry_payment becomes available again if the other retry conditions allow it. Only one retry may be in progress at a time. Buyers can start a retry while fewer than 3 retries have been created for the current billing period, counting the store's retries too. subscription_card_update email-link sessions can start retries. When the store cannot accept payments, a new payment fails with 409 MERCHANT_NOT_READY and reason processing_restricted. Changes billed at a future renewal remain available. A closed store is read-only: commerce changes fail with 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED and reason terminal_status. Receipts and order history remain readable.
post.summary: Retry the failed payment on one of the current buyer's subscriptions

get.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. Returns one durable manual subscription payment retry.
get.summary: Get a payment retry for one of the current buyer's subscriptions

post.description: Charges the next renewal now, ships it when the subscription has delivery, and moves the next billing date forward by one interval. Available while the subscription is active on a Flint-owned billing schedule (billing_schedule_owner is flint), is not set to cancel at the end of its period, is not in a trial, and has no delivery hold or renewal in progress. The subscription's payment method must be active and allow off-session charges. Requires a full buyer session and an idempotency key. Send expected_version to reject concurrent changes. Retry with the same key to recover the same attempt. Returns the subscription, renewal order, and payment attempt, including when the payment is declined. Inspect order_payment_attempt.last_payment_error for a failed payment. When the store cannot accept payments, a new payment fails with 409 MERCHANT_NOT_READY and reason processing_restricted. Changes billed at a future renewal remain available. A closed store is read-only: commerce changes fail with 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED and reason terminal_status. Receipts and order history remain readable.

Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Asks Flint to resume a paused subscription. The request is accepted while the subscription is still paused, with `resume_requested_at` set. Flint then makes it active, or past_due while an overdue period is collected, and sends subscription.resumed. While prepaid deliveries remain, resuming makes no charge and shifts later deliveries and the next charge by the length of the pause. If Flint can't resume it, it stays paused, resume_requested_at clears, and Flint sends subscription.updated. Any other status fails with `ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED`. To undo a scheduled cancellation, PATCH the subscription with cancel_at_period_end set to false. When the store cannot accept payments, a new payment fails with 409 MERCHANT_NOT_READY and reason processing_restricted. Changes billed at a future renewal remain available. A closed store is read-only: commerce changes fail with 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED and reason terminal_status. Receipts and order history remain readable.
post.summary: Resume one of the current buyer's subscriptions

post.description: While prepaid deliveries remain, defers the next delivery and next charge by one delivery interval without consuming a delivery. Otherwise skips the next renewal without charging or shipping and moves the next billing date forward by one billing interval while preserving billing_anchor_day, including in shorter months. Available when buyer skipping is enabled and the subscription is active on a Flint-owned billing schedule (billing_schedule_owner is flint), is not set to cancel at the end of its period, and is under the store's consecutive skip limit. Requires a full buyer session. Send expected_version to reject concurrent changes. A closed store is read-only: commerce changes fail with 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED and reason terminal_status. Receipts and order history remain readable.

get.description: Lists the event tickets on the buyer's orders, newest first, with each ticket's admission code for showing its QR code. Voided tickets are listed without an admission code. Admission codes go only to buyers Flint verified: a buyer session whose email Flint confirmed (hosted sign-in or the paid checkout's sign-in), on orders whose buyer_email is that email, or an order link from the paying checkout or emailed to the order's buyer_email. Merchant access links, customer sessions created with an API key, and checkout links a merchant reads or requests after payment list the tickets without admission codes; use rotate-code to deliver tickets yourself. Default order: created_at descending, then ticket_id descending.
Returns the authenticated merchant.

patch.description: Applies a sparse update to the authenticated merchant's profile, shared across live and all sandboxes. Every mutable field requires a live-mode credential or a Dashboard session in any selected environment. Test credentials fail with `FORBIDDEN` and reason `live_mode_required`, with one detail per supplied shared field, including nulls and metadata changes. Nothing is saved on refusal. A partner app install token can change only `business_name`, `icon`, and `logo`; another field returns `400 INVALID_REQUEST` with a `NOT_ALLOWED` detail whose `param` names it.

post.description: Creates a fresh provider session from a signed launch token after rechecking the authenticated principal, merchant environment, account controller, and component grant. An onboarding session can refresh only sandbox launch tokens created by the same user with an onboarding session. The sandbox is pinned by the launch token, which is the merchant's default sandbox for an onboarding session. Live onboarding requires a live API key or live CLI login. A partner install token works in live mode only while its app's merchant_onboarding platform capability is active; otherwise it gets 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with the reason its platform status gives: platform_onboarding_required, platform_pending_review, platform_rejected, or platform_capability_inactive. Refresh requires the same credential that created the launch token. For an install token, that is any access token for the same environment grant and consent; revoking the install or grant, or authorizing again, ends the launch token. A same-key, same-input retry replays the encrypted original result for 24 hours, including its original credentials and expiries. Replay may return an expired credential. Use a new key for a new launch or refresh.

x-flint-conditional-scopes.when: Required when the launch token's components include payments.

post.description: Creates an embedded browser handoff for one or more allowlisted account components. The credential selects the environment; the onboarding session token acts in the merchant's default sandbox. A partner install token works in live mode only while its app's merchant_onboarding platform capability is active; otherwise it gets 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with the reason its platform status gives: platform_onboarding_required, platform_pending_review, platform_rejected, or platform_capability_inactive. A same-key, same-input retry replays the encrypted original result for 24 hours, including its original credentials and expiries. Replay may return an expired credential. Use a new key for a new launch or refresh.

get.description: Returns what the merchant currently owes Flint and owns as account credit by currency. All balances fit on one page, so next_page_token is omitted. Default order: merchant_billing_balance_id descending; this key uniquely orders the results.
Returns what the merchant currently owes Flint and owns as account credit in one currency.

Returns immutable merchant billing entries for the authenticated merchant environment, newest occurred_at first. Entries in the same second are ordered by type rank, then merchant_billing_entry_id; all three keys are descending. Type ranks are 10 for event_fee, custom_domain, and invoice; 20 for correction; 30 for credit_issued; 40 for credit_applied and credit_refunded; 50 for collection and custom_domain_collection; and 60 for collection_reversal and write_off. An entry can be recorded after entries that occurred later, such as a collection whose bank outcome arrives late. created_at is set when Flint records an entry and never changes or uses a source event timestamp. To pick up new entries, filter on created_after. Overlap successive passes by a few minutes and deduplicate by merchant_billing_entry_id because concurrent commits can become visible after a pass finishes. Re-reading the same entry always returns the same values. To export an interval, use merchant_billing_itemized_v1. It fails with data_unavailable when billing projections or membership history are inconsistent, collection outcome or balance transaction evidence is missing, or an entry is invalid. This list does not run the report interval preflights. Default order: occurred_at descending, then the entry type's rank (descending), then merchant_billing_entry_id descending.
Returns invoices issued by Flint for the authenticated merchant environment. Default order: merchant_billing_invoice_id descending; this key uniquely orders the results.
Returns one invoice issued by Flint for the authenticated merchant environment.

Lists the signups of your partner apps, newest first, then by `merchant_signup_id`. A merchant that owns no app gets an empty list. Live only: test credentials get 403 FORBIDDEN with reason live_mode_required, and a key linked to a partner app install gets 403 FORBIDDEN with reason linked_key_not_allowed. Partner app tokens can't call it. Default order: created_at descending, then merchant_signup_id descending.

post.description: Starts creating a merchant for an owner: Flint emails the owner a code that names your app, the business, the permissions and fee cap you request, and Flint's merchant terms. Show the owner Flint's terms checkbox in your form, collect the code, and send both to verify. Flint checks, in order and before any email: the partner app is yours and active (404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND at partner_app_id, or 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason unsupported_state for a deleted app); every requested_permission_ids value is in the manifest (400 INVALID_VALUE at that item); the app has a merchant_action_url, and its name and permission titles hold no link (409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason configuration_required); the app's live create_merchants capability; then the quotas. Until create_merchants is active, modes including live are refused with 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED, capability create_merchants, param modes and the capability's inactive reason, and an owner outside your merchant's team is refused the same way with param owner.email. Quotas: 20 signups per app per UTC day before create_merchants is active and 1,000 after (409 LIMIT_REACHED with reason merchant_signups, limit and resets_at); 3 codes per owner mailbox per 15 minutes across every app (429 RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED with Retry-After) and 10 per 24 hours (409 LIMIT_REACHED with reason verification_codes). Plus-addresses count as their mailbox. The response never says whether the email already has a Flint login. Live only: test credentials get 403 FORBIDDEN with reason live_mode_required, and a key linked to a partner app install gets 403 FORBIDDEN with reason linked_key_not_allowed. Partner app tokens can't call it.

get.description: Returns one of your partner apps' signups. A completed signup stays readable, including the owner's name and email, after the merchant disconnects the app. Live only: test credentials get 403 FORBIDDEN with reason live_mode_required, and a key linked to a partner app install gets 403 FORBIDDEN with reason linked_key_not_allowed. Partner app tokens can't call it.

post.description: Cancels a `pending` signup and voids its code, so a code email still queued is never sent. A canceled signup returns 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason already_applied; any other status, including a signup Flint is completing after verify, returns reason unsupported_state with current_status. Live only: test credentials get 403 FORBIDDEN with reason live_mode_required, and a key linked to a partner app install gets 403 FORBIDDEN with reason linked_key_not_allowed. Partner app tokens can't call it.

Emails the owner a new code for a `pending` signup. The new code replaces the old one and resets the attempt count; a code email still queued for the old code is never sent. A signup sends at most 3 codes (409 LIMIT_REACHED with reason verification_codes and limit 3), within the per-mailbox send caps of create. The app's create_merchants capability is checked again, so a paused platform sends no more codes. Any other status returns 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason unsupported_state. It is a message operation, not a lifecycle action, so supported_actions never lists it. Live only: test credentials get 403 FORBIDDEN with reason live_mode_required, and a key linked to a partner app install gets 403 FORBIDDEN with reason linked_key_not_allowed. Partner app tokens can't call it.
post.summary: Send a new merchant signup code

post.description: Mints new authorization codes for a completed signup's grants that were never exchanged, bound to the signup's code_challenge, and supersedes the earlier ones. Use it when the verify response was lost or the codes expired before you exchanged them. It works only within 24 hours of completed_at and while nothing else has happened to the install: any revoke, or an authorization of the app on the consent screen, ends it for good. Refused with 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED: reason already_applied once every grant has been exchanged (mint partner app tokens with grant_type=client_credentials instead), unsupported_state when the signup isn't completed, and not_offered once the window or the install's state ends rotation; the owner then reauthorizes on the consent screen. An idempotent replay returns the signup without the codes. It is a code rotation, not a lifecycle action, so supported_actions never lists it. Live only: test credentials get 403 FORBIDDEN with reason live_mode_required, and a key linked to a partner app install gets 403 FORBIDDEN with reason linked_key_not_allowed. Partner app tokens can't call it.
post.summary: Mint new authorization codes for a merchant signup

post.description: Uses the owner's code and their acceptance of Flint's merchant terms, then creates the merchant, installs the app on it in the signup's modes, and returns one authorization code per mode. Exchange each at POST /v1/oauth/token with the code_verifier for the signup's code_challenge and without redirect_uri, within 5 minutes. Checks, in order, before any effect: the signup is pending (409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason already_applied when completed, unsupported_state with current_status otherwise); the app's create_merchants capability again; the attempt caps (409 LIMIT_REACHED with reason verification_attempts: 5 wrong codes use up a code, and wrong codes for one owner mailbox are capped at 10 per 24 hours and 30 per 7 days, with resets_at); the code. A wrong, expired or replaced code is 400 INVALID_REQUEST with INVALID_VALUE at verification_code. After the code matches, an owner Flint can't use is refused with 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED and reason owner_identity_conflict (the owner contacts Flint support, then you resend a code or start a new signup), and an owner who already owns 10 active merchants with 409 LIMIT_REACHED and reason owned_merchants. Completion is resumable. Once the code is used, Flint finishes creating the merchant even if this request fails; a failure returns 503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE. Send verify again, with the same Idempotency-Key or a new one and the same code, to wait for or continue the same completion and get the result. An idempotent replay returns the signup without the codes: mint new ones with rotate-authorization-codes. Live only: test credentials get 403 FORBIDDEN with reason live_mode_required, and a key linked to a partner app install gets 403 FORBIDDEN with reason linked_key_not_allowed. Partner app tokens can't call it.

get.description: List modifier groups. Default order: created_at descending, then modifier_group_id descending.

post.description: Creates a modifier group, a set of choices that customize an item, such as toppings or a custom message. Send `name`. A list group offers the choices in `modifiers`, with limits on how many buyers select; a text group takes a text entry instead, and sending `text` makes the group a text group. Attach groups to products, variants, and bundles through a modifier set. Defaults must stay within the group's selection limits.

delete.description: Archives a modifier group so buyers are no longer offered it, and returns its final state. A group that a modifier set which isn't archived still uses fails with `RESOURCE_IN_USE`; remove it from those sets, or archive them, first. Returns the archived resource as a read does. Deleting an already archived resource returns it again without changing its version or `updated_at`, sending a webhook, or checking references. A stale `expected_version` fails with `VERSION_CONFLICT` and the `current_version`, even when the resource is already archived.

get.description: Returns one modifier group by ID, with its choices, selection limits, and whether it appears on receipts and in fulfillment details.

patch.description: Applies a sparse update to a modifier group: only the fields you send change. Sending `modifiers` replaces the whole list; modifiers you leave out are archived, and `expected_version` is required with it. A stale version fails with `VERSION_CONFLICT`. Fails with `ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED` and reason `archived` when the resource, or the parent it belongs to, is archived. The error names the archived resource and its `current_status`.

get.description: List modifier sets. Default order: created_at descending, then modifier_set_id descending.

post.description: Creates a modifier set, a reusable collection of modifier groups that you attach to products, variants, and bundles by `modifier_set_id`. Send `name` and the ordered `modifier_groups`, each referencing a reusable group or defining a group owned by the set.

delete.description: Archives a modifier set and returns its final state.
